baseline.definition: Incumbent quality-head recipe refit per fold on outer-train: unweighted closed-form ridge alpha=100 (intercept column unpenalized) on standardized 14-d structural features, direct target scores[:,1]-scores[:,0]. Mirrors the shipped cost-calibrated-router.v1 quality head.
baseline.name: incumbent-ridge-refit

challenger_gbm.definition: HistGradientBoostingRegressor(max_iter=200, learning_rate=0.1, min_samples_leaf=20, l2_regularization=1.0, early_stopping=False, random_state=20260816) on the same 14-d structural features, direct delta-31 target. Represents the boosted-tree uplift class (GBM team / hwkim3330 cost-side class).
challenger_gbm.name: gbm-histgb-uplift

challenger_routerx.definition: TfidfVectorizer(word ngram(1,2), max_features=60000) hstacked with TfidfVectorizer(char_wb ngram(3,5), max_features=120000), fitted on outer-train texts only, then Ridge(alpha=1.0) on the sparse design, direct delta-31 target. Represents RouterX's high-dimensional lexical uplift head.
challenger_routerx.name: routerx-tfidf-uplift

challenger_shin.definition: IRT-lite: theta(x) = ridge alpha=100 prediction of s_light from [standardized 14-d structural; signed L2-normalized hashed uni+bigram into 512 bins]; per-model LogisticRegression(C=10) calibrates each model's score band (score >= outer-train median of that model's score) against theta; arm uplift = p_ax31 - p_light. Declared approximation of Shin LPB's shared-ability 2PL form whose exact calibration is unpublished.
challenger_shin.name: shin-irt-ability

context_frozen.allocator: feasibility_ladder.select_fast_balanced with the bundled family-guard artifact caps, runaway_fraction and max_upgrade_fraction; guarded_prediction repricing applied to costs only.
context_frozen.note: Costs, caps, guard multipliers and every allocator constant stay shipped/frozen. Only the uplift vector feeding fast/balanced selection varies between arms.
context_frozen.premium_scope: Premium decisions are identical across arms and cancel in paired deltas; competitor honest gaps concentrate in Light-to-AX31 ranking where weight 0.7 lives.

decision_reasons.fail: No challenger head cleared the pre-registered gates on fresh seeds. The incumbent recipe stays champion and our position is confirmed by paired evidence.
decision_reasons.pass: A challenger head beat the incumbent recipe through the actual serving path on fresh seeds. This opens a promotion window only; integration requires a separate sealed protocol.

metric.delta_definition: Paired official weighted score difference (arm minus baseline): 0.4*deltaQ_fast + 0.3*deltaQ_balanced pooled per seed over held-out folds; premium contributes zero.
metric.family_decomposition: delta_f = 0.4*(n_f/N)*meanDiffFast_f + 0.3*(n_f/N)*meanDiffBalanced_f so that family deltas sum to the pooled delta.
metric.protocol_note: Runtime-in-the-loop: identical to e5-brake-conditioned-v1 but injected at the fast/balanced ladder selection instead of the premium brake.

multi_arm_rule: If several arms clear every gate, the window opens for the arm with the highest mean delta; ties resolve toward the simpler model (baseline < histgb < tfidf < irt).

seed_derivation.algorithm: digest_i = SHA256(UTF8(PREFIX) + NUL + bytes.fromhex(CORE) + i.to_bytes(4,'big')); seed_i = int.from_bytes(digest_i[:4],'big') & 0x7fffffff; collision fails closed.
